history.content: What am I forgetting before I leave for Denver Thursday?

Here's what I checked: your calendar (Mon, Thu), your mail from the last week, and your reminders. The trip itself is covered, Southwest WN 2214, JFK→DEN, 3:40pm Thursday, and Zephyr Lodge with 3pm check in. Nothing on your calendar Thursday or Friday, so no conflicts to untangle. What you might be forgetting: 1. Sam Cohen's contract, he said he'd review by Friday, which is while you're away. The email is drafted for your review — nothing has been sent yet. 2. Sarah Kim is still waiting on the updated deck. If you don't send it before Thursday, that's two people waiting on you at once. 3. Dana's panel email says "tomorrow, panel details" (product + engineering leads, 45 min product case, 100 Main St, 9th floor). Your calendar only shows a BigCo interview Monday at 2pm, worth confirming which day that panel actually lands before you're on a plane. 4. No reminders set at all. Want me to add a Thursday morning one for the flight and packing? Also unverified: I haven't checked whether you've actually checked in for the flight, Southwest check in opens 24 hours out, so Wednesday 3:40pm. I can't do check in for you, but I can set a reminder for it. Want both reminders?
